description: Used to display progress (0-100 scale) or a loading state.

props.absolute: Applies position: absolute to the component.
props.active: Reduce the height to 0, hiding component.
props.bgOpacity: Background opacity, if null it defaults to 0.3 if background color is not specified or 1 otherwise.
props.bufferColor: Sets the color of the buffer bar.
props.bufferOpacity: Set the opacity of the buffer bar.
props.bufferValue: The percentage value for the buffer.
props.chunkCount: Specifies amount of chunks to divide the bar into.
props.chunkGap: Defines size of the gap between chunks.
props.chunkWidth: Defines chunk absolute size. Useful when chunk is narrow.
props.clickable: Clicking on the progress track will automatically set the value.
props.indeterminate: Constantly animates, use when loading progress is unknown.
props.max: Sets the maximum value the progress can reach.
props.opacity: Set the opacity of the progress bar.
props.reveal: Animates the progress bar from 0 to its model value when the component mounts.
props.reverse: Displays reversed progress (right to left in LTR mode and left to right in RTL).
props.roundedBar: Applies a border radius to the progress bar.
props.stream: An alternative style for portraying loading that works in tandem with **buffer-value**.
props.striped: Adds a stripe background to the filled portion of the progress component.
props.shape: Sets the shape of the filled portion. **wavy** draws it as an animated wave, applies the **split** gap and grows the bar to fit the wave.
props.stopIndicator: Shows a dot marking the end of the track. When not set, only the **wavy** shape shows it. Set to `true` to show it with the **split** variant as well, or `false` to hide it.
props.transition: Controls the animation to a new value. Pass `{ duration }` in milliseconds or as a CSS duration (e.g. `0.4s`), or `false` to remove it. Does not affect `indeterminate`, `stream` or `striped` animations.
props.variant: Applies a distinct style to the component. **split** visually divides the progress bar at the current value, separating the filled and unfilled portions with a gap.

slots.default: Provides the current value of the component.
